transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. __. What brings you in today?

...Well, I suppose I'm here because of my husband's sister. She's... she's been working this family business, trying to get control of the money. Pushing me out of the decisions. Folks keep trying to smooth it all over, but... I know what I've been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable for several days?
No... I don't think so. I haven't felt like that. I'm just... regular, I guess. I don't get all energetic like you're saying.
Do you ever hear or see things that other people do not?
No. No, I don't. I just see what's right in front of me, same as anyone else would if they were paying attention.
Have you noticed any changes in your thinking or behavior, like feeling confused, having trouble organizing your thoughts, or becoming more socially withdrawn?
No... I'm not confused. My mind works just fine. I haven't noticed any changes like that.
Have you had any head injury, seizure, or other medical problem around the time these beliefs started?
No... nothing like that. I haven't hit my head or... had any seizures. I'm healthy.
Has anyone else in your family business actually tried to control the money or push you out?

Well... it's my husband’s sister. She’s been working the family business just so she can get control of the money... and push me out of the decisions. Folks try to smooth it all over, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now.
Do you believe anyone is sending messages to you, or trying to communicate with you in a hidden way?
No. Nobody's doing that. Just... regular talking. Nothing hidden.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a fixed persecutory/jealous-style delusional belief centered on her husband’s sister trying to control the family business and money, persisting for more than one year.
